# Allowed findings of TestNoInPlaceBinaryWrites (inplace_guard_test.go).
# One per line: <file> <func> <rule>  # reason. A line matching nothing fails the test.

# The one signer. It is only ever handed a temp path (EnsureSigned, ResignByReplace,
# Install and InstallReader in the same package).
internal/binsign/binsign.go Codesign.Sign adhocsign  # k3sm's single signing entry point; callers sign temps only

# k3sm install builds a whole staged tree and swaps it in with one rename, so the
# shadow copies it signs are fresh clones nothing has mapped yet.
pkg/install/shadow.go makeShadowSet adhocsign  # signs a fresh clone inside the staged tree, before the swap
pkg/install/shadow_darwin.go darwinSystem.AdHocSign adhocsign  # the install System seam over image.AdHocSign; only makeShadowSet calls it
